title: 第二十三章 人才市场第二十四章 韩老头
slug: 凡人修仙苟在废丹房我偷偷成仙了
content_zh:
三丫的话无可挑剔，许天也默认。
只是在走出洞口那一刻，她回头深深看了一眼阴影里的许天。
“许天，你的秘密......老娘早晚会挖出来。”
随着三丫的身影消失在夜色中，洞穴里只剩下许天和李狗蛋。
气氛变得有些压抑。
捂着流血肩膀，李狗蛋靠在岩壁上，眼神阴郁看着许天。
他也想走。
他也想去寻找自己机缘，而不是给这装货当狗。
但他不敢。
体内许天冲下的禁制，就像一把悬在头顶的剑。
更别提丹田里那颗沉睡魔种，目前只有许天能压制。
“怎么？你也想走？”
掏出一瓶药粉，许天扔给李狗蛋。
“哼。”
李狗蛋接过药粉，闷声道：“我体内有你禁制，又有魔种，我能去哪？”
“算你聪明。”
许天淡淡一笑：
“放心，只要你乖乖听话，我也不会亏待你。”
“这外门水深，咱们同乡之间，还得互相帮衬不是？”
“帮衬？”

李狗蛋心中冷笑，面上却不得不低头。
一边敷药，他一边试探着问道：
“许哥，三丫去了合欢峰，那咱们呢？难道就在这破洞里躲一辈子？”
“我听说外门每个月都有入峰考核。”
“只要通过考核，加入九大主峰，才能算真正外门弟子，才能学到高深功法。”
说到最后几个字，李狗蛋语气加重。
他打听过了。
虽说凭借外门弟子身份，他们可以凭贡献点购买功法，但都是较为基础的。
而魔修在翻山宗并没有明确山峰接纳，属于小教派。
自己如今想要修炼，只能加入炼体宗门，寻求机遇。
当自己修为成功超越许天时，就是他的死期！
瞥了他一眼，许天看穿他那点小心思，却并没有点破。
“入峰考核......”
摸了摸下巴，许天嘴角微翘。
“确实是个好去处。不过在此之前，我们得先活下去。”
他站起身，走到洞口，看着外面那漆黑如墨的乱石谷。
“狗蛋，明天开始，我们得去接任务。”
“什么脏活累活都行，关键是给要打听清楚外门规矩。”
李狗蛋一愣，随即咬牙点头：“知道了。”
他看着许天的背影，心中暗暗发誓：

“忍！老子一定要忍！”
“等老子通过考核，进了主峰，学了神通......”
content_en:
Sanya's words were impeccable, and Xu Tian agreed.
Just when she walked out of the cave, she turned back and took a deep look at Xu Tian in the shadow.
"Xu Tian, your secret... I will dig it out sooner or later."
As Sanya's figure disappeared into the night, only Xu Tian and Li Goudan were left in the cave.
The atmosphere became somewhat depressing.
Holding his bleeding shoulder, Li Goudan leaned against the rock wall and looked at Xu Tian with gloomy eyes.
He also wants to leave.
He also wanted to find his own opportunities instead of being a dog for this guy.
But he didn't dare.
The restriction in Xu Tianchong's body was like a sword hanging above his head.
Not to mention the sleeping demon seed in Dantian, which only Xu Tian can suppress at present.
"What? You want to leave too?"
Xu Tian took out a bottle of medicinal powder and threw it to Li Goudan.
"Hmph."
Li Goudan took the medicine powder and said in a low voice: "With your restriction in my body and the demon seed, where can I go?"
"You're smart."
Xu Tian smiled faintly:
"Don't worry, as long as you obey me, I won't treat you badly."
"The outer gate is deep in water. We fellow villagers have to help each other, right?"
"Help?"
Li Goudan sneered in his heart, but had to bow his head.
While applying the medicine, he asked tentatively:
"Brother Xu, Sanya went to Hehuan Peak, what about us? Are we going to hide in this hole for the rest of our lives?"
"I heard that the outer sect has entrance exams every month."
"Only those who pass the assessment and join the nine main peaks can be considered a true outer sect disciple and learn advanced techniques."
Speaking of the last few words, Li Goudan's tone became more serious.
He asked.
Although as outer disciples, they can purchase exercises with contribution points, they are all relatively basic.
However, the Demonic Cultivators in Fanshan Sect have not clearly accepted the mountain peak, and they belong to a small sect.
If he wants to practice now, he can only join the Body Refining Sect and seek opportunities.
When he succeeds in surpassing Xu Tian in cultivation, it will be his death!
Glancing at him, Xu Tian saw through his little thoughts, but did not reveal them.
"Enter the peak assessment..."
Touching his chin, Xu Tian raised the corners of his mouth slightly.
"It is indeed a good place. But before that, we have to survive."
He stood up, walked to the entrance of the cave, and looked out at the dark rocky valley.
"Goudan, starting tomorrow, we have to pick up the mission."
"Any dirty work is fine. The key is to understand the rules of the outer sect."
Li Goudan was stunned for a moment, then gritted his teeth and nodded: "I understand."
He looked at Xu Tian's back and secretly swore:
"Patience! I must endure it!"
"When I pass the test, enter the main peak, and learn magical powers..."
